    Boards & Committees

    Affordable Housing Advisory Committee

    Fulfills Florida Statute requirements regarding the Local Housing Assistance Plan.

    • Affordable Housing Advisory Committee

    Art In Public Places Committee

    The five-person BOCC-appointed committee reviews and recommends proposals for commissioned permanent public art. Projects are funded by the “1% for Art” ordinance created in 2001. It strives to promote and support the vibrant arts community by enhancing public buildings throughout Monroe County.

    • Art in Public Places Committee

    Construction Board of Adjustments and Appeals

    Hears discrepancies in interpretations of the current county building codes.

    • Construction Board of Adjustments and Appeals

    Contractors Examining Board

    A quasi-judicial code enforcement board that hears public complaints regarding unlicensed contractor code violations and imposes penalties for unlicensed contractor code violations.

    • Contractors Examining Board

    Development Review Committee

    A committee that reviews applications for development approval and for amendments to the text of the Comprehensive Plan, the Land Development Code, and maps.

    • Development Review Committee

    Duck Key Security District Advisory Board

    Provides security services for the residential areas of Duck Key.

    • Duck Key Security District Advisory Board

    Florida Keys Transportation Coordination Committee

    Studies and research traffic issues to create formal recommendations for the governing bodies of the five municipalities and the BOCC. The committee updates the list of priority transportation projects for the Florida Keys, which is formally submitted to FDOT for use in its five-year work plan.

    • Florida Keys Transportation Coordination Committee

    Historic Preservation Commission

    Designates and regulates historic properties within the county's unincorporated area.

    • Historic Preservation Commission

    Key West International Airport Ad Hoc Committee on Noise

    Acts as a conduit on issues related to airport and aircraft noise.

    • KWIA Ad Hoc Committee on Noise

    Land Authority Advisory Committee

    Makes recommendations to BOCC on matters related to Land Authority property acquisitions.

    • Land Authority Advisory Committee

    Parks and Recreation Advisory Board

    The 5-person BOCC-appointed board reviews existing facilities, programs, expenditures, and revenues and makes recommendations for improvements, additional facilities, and programs.

    • Parks and Recreation Advisory Board

    Planning Commission

    The 5-person BOCC-appointed board serves as the local planning agency. Reviews proposed amendments to the Comprehensive Plan, Land Development Code, and map amendments, and provides recommendations to the BOCC. The committee also reviews and either approves or disapproves applications for major conditional use permits, variances, and Rate of Growth Ordinance (ROGO) awards.

    • Planning Commission

    Shared Asset Forfeiture Fund Advisory Board

    Recommends grant funding to private, nonprofit organizations using money from the Sheriff’s Office’s forfeitures and seized assets.

    • Shared Asset Forfeiture Fund Advisory Board
    • Contact: Michelle Quad, 305-292-7090, mquad@keysso.net

    Substance Abuse Policy Advisory Board

    Reviews and recommends applications for funding under the Florida Department of Law Enforcement’s Byrne Justice Assistance Grant Program and the Clerk’s Drug Abuse Trust Fund. This board also serves as the county’s Planning Council for the Florida Department of Children and Families' Office of Criminal Justice, Mental Health, and Substance Abuse.

    • Substance Abuse Policy Advisory Board

    Tourist Development Council

    Sets an overall direction for the tourism marketing effort to ensure long-term, sustained growth in tourism revenues and the sustainability of resources.

    • Tourist Development Council

    Appeals

    If a person decides to appeal any decision made by the board with respect to any matter considered at such meeting or hearing, he or she will need a record of the proceedings, and that, for such purpose, he or she may need to ensure that a verbatim record of the proceedings is made, which record includes the testimony and evidence upon which the appeal is to be based.

    ADA Assistance

    If you are a person with a disability who needs special accommodations in order to participate in meeting proceedings, please contact the County Administrator’s Office, by phoning 305-292-4441, between the hours of 8:30 a.m. and 5 p.m., no later than five (5) calendar days prior to the scheduled meeting; if you are hearing or voice impaired, call "711."

    • Accommodation Request Form
